install_script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
setup_root=/workspace/.medusa-environment
mkdir -p "$setup_root/bin"
export npm_config_cache="$setup_root/npm-cache"
npm install --prefix "$setup_root/toolchain" --no-audit --no-fund node@22.23.3
cat > "$setup_root/bin/yarn" <<'YARN'
#!/bin/sh
exec /workspace/.medusa-environment/toolchain/node_modules/node/bin/node /workspace/medusa/.yarn/releases/yarn-3.2.1.cjs "$@"
YARN
chmod +x "$setup_root/bin/yarn"
cat > "$setup_root/activate.sh" <<'ACTIVATE'
export PATH=/workspace/.medusa-environment/toolchain/node_modules/node/bin:/workspace/.medusa-environment/bin:$PATH
export npm_config_cache=/workspace/.medusa-environment/npm-cache
export YARN_GLOBAL_FOLDER=/workspace/.medusa-environment/yarn-global
export YARN_CHECKSUM_BEHAVIOR=throw
export YARN_NM_MODE=hardlinks-local
export YARN_HTTP_PROXY="${HTTP_PROXY:-${http_proxy:-}}"
export YARN_HTTPS_PROXY="${HTTPS_PROXY:-${https_proxy:-}}"
ACTIVATE
source "$setup_root/activate.sh"
cd /workspace/medusa
yarn install --immutable --inline-builds
yarn turbo run build --filter=@medusajs/utils... --concurrency=2 --no-daemon

# Retained MIT SaaS coding fork (requires the published workspace snapshot).
if [ -f /workspace/.medusa-baseline/mit-source/saas/BASELINE.json ]; then
  source /workspace/.medusa-baseline/activate.sh
  export XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/workspace/.medusa-baseline/config
  mkdir -p "$XDG_CONFIG_HOME"
  cd /workspace/.medusa-baseline/mit-source
  yarn install --immutable --inline-builds
  yarn turbo run build --filter=integration-tests-http... --concurrency=3 --no-daemon
  yarn workspace @medusajs/loyalty-plugin build:plugin
  node saas/check-baseline.cjs
fi

# M3 native Admin/reference storefront build; no test reset or production migration.
if [ -f /workspace/.medusa-baseline/mit-source/saas/storefront/package.json ]; then
  source /workspace/.medusa-baseline/activate.sh
  cd /workspace/.medusa-baseline/mit-source
  SAAS_ARTIFACT_DIR=/workspace/.medusa-baseline/m3-build bash saas/build-m3.sh
fi


# Current MIT SaaS application: store-saas/saas-mvp.
# Preserve existing checkouts and local work. Clone only when the path is absent.
if [ ! -e /workspace/store-saas ]; then
  git clone --branch saas-mvp --single-branch https://github.com/victors2021/store-saas.git /workspace/store-saas
fi
if [ ! -f /workspace/store-saas/saas/BASELINE.json ]; then
  echo "Current store-saas checkout is missing; restore or clone it without replacing existing local work" >&2
  exit 1
fi
saas_setup_root=/workspace/.store-saas-environment
mkdir -p "$saas_setup_root/bin" "$saas_setup_root/config"
cat > "$saas_setup_root/bin/yarn" <<'SAAS_YARN'
#!/bin/sh
exec /workspace/.medusa-environment/toolchain/node_modules/node/bin/node /workspace/store-saas/.yarn/releases/yarn-3.2.1.cjs "$@"
SAAS_YARN
chmod +x "$saas_setup_root/bin/yarn"
cat > "$saas_setup_root/activate.sh" <<'SAAS_ACTIVATE'
source /workspace/.medusa-environment/activate.sh
export PATH=/workspace/.store-saas-environment/bin:$PATH
export YARN_CACHE_FOLDER=/workspace/medusa/.yarn/cache
export NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096
export XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/workspace/.store-saas-environment/config
SAAS_ACTIVATE
source "$saas_setup_root/activate.sh"
cd /workspace/store-saas
yarn install --immutable --inline-builds
yarn turbo run build --filter=integration-tests-http... --filter=@medusajs/payment-stripe... --concurrency=3 --no-daemon
yarn workspace @medusajs/loyalty-plugin build:plugin
node saas/check-baseline.cjs
SAAS_ARTIFACT_DIR=/workspace/.store-saas-verification/setup bash saas/build-m3.sh
# No production migration, test reset, provider calls, or live-money operation here.
start_skill:
Current coding checkout: /workspace/store-saas, branch saas-mvp, origin victors2021/store-saas.
Read README.md, docs/saas/16-M5-IMPLEMENTATION.md, docs/saas/17-M5-CODE-REVIEW.md, docs/saas/18-OPERATIONS-RUNBOOK.md and saas/M5-README.md first. Read saas/M4-README.md for actual Stripe acceptance.
Use source /workspace/.store-saas-environment/activate.sh and cd /workspace/store-saas.
Original /workspace/medusa develop and historical /workspace/.medusa-baseline/mit-source are references: preserve local work, M0-M4 evidence, root MIT LICENSE/manifest/lockfile and storefront license/lockfile. Do not code in or reset the old checkouts or create worktrees unless requested.
Read the cloud-environment runtime skill before managed networking/Docker work. Use the session proxy and CA; do not extract credentials or bypass network denials.
Install uses Node 22.23.3, bundled root Yarn 3.2.1 and storefront Yarn 4.12.0. Setup has been tested in the installed workspace; fresh snapshot restoration/new-machine installation is still unverified.
Verification: bash saas/start-services.sh, then SAAS_ARTIFACT_DIR=/workspace/.store-saas-verification/m5 bash saas/verify-m5.sh. The strict script includes M0-M4, production builds, M5 HTTP/upgrade/encrypted backup/restore/launcher/browser. Docker PG/Redis are pinned and loopback-only. Only explicitly marked disposable databases are reset; shared fixtures run serially. Never redirect reset flags to live data. Python Playwright and system Chromium are required.
M5 implements the platform console, one manual pilot plan, SQL-atomic product/upload quotas, paid-order handling during suspension, limits/audit/fair queues/worker readiness, bounded cleanup and offline encrypted full database/object/key backup and empty-target restore. Reuse native Admin Operations; no separate merchant UI or AI work.
M5 adds 0007-operations and actual schema/RLS/grant/constraint/trigger/function verification. Stop old gateway/worker/direct writers and take a matching M4 snapshot before node saas/migrate-m5-command.cjs. Migration requires SAAS_MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL, SAAS_APPLICATION_ROLE, SAAS_JWT_SECRET, absolute actual SAAS_OBJECT_ROOT. Preserve persistent keys and verified legacy objects. Initialize old M2 tenants explicitly only if needed with SAAS_ENABLE_OPERATIONS=true. Build, then node saas/start-m5.cjs behind reviewed TLS/Host ingress; actual worker defaults on. Old M4 code cannot use an M5 database: rollback requires matching code/database/objects/keys, never dropping checks or auto-resetting.
Runtime inputs remain SAAS_DATABASE_URL, SAAS_BASE_DOMAIN, SAAS_PLATFORM_ACTOR_ID, SAAS_JWT_SECRET, SAAS_CONTEXT_SECRET, SAAS_IDENTITY_SECRET, SAAS_PLATFORM_KEY, SAAS_OBJECT_ROOT and independent 32-byte hex SAAS_PAYMENT_KEY. Supply secrets securely, never values in source/chat/logs. The platform actor must be explicitly provisioned and active. All SaaS/Stripe backend secrets stay out of the Next child environment.
Offline backup inputs only: SAAS_BACKUP_KEY (independent 32-byte hex), SAAS_BACKUP_DATABASE_URL (full administrative RLS-bypass), SAAS_BACKUP_OUTPUT, SAAS_APPLICATION_ROLE, SAAS_OBJECT_ROOT and the five current runtime keys. Restore inputs: SAAS_BACKUP_INPUT, SAAS_BACKUP_KEY, SAAS_RESTORE_DATABASE_URL, SAAS_RESTORE_EMPTY_DATABASE, SAAS_APPLICATION_ROLE, SAAS_RESTORE_OBJECT_ROOT, optional SAAS_RESTORE_KEYS_OUTPUT outside source. All paths absolute. Tools refuse overwrites, existing targets and weak remote PostgreSQL TLS. Standard pg_dump/pg_restore/tar required; container tool mode is only for owned loopback disposable fixtures. Never log/export keys to the repository. Read the runbook before any operator action.
Backup tests restore on an independent PostgreSQL instance on the same physical host. Actual off-host copy/restore remains pending; local receipt is not off-host verification. No target host/storage credentials are configured, and no destination/domain has been invented. Reconcile vendor actions since the snapshot before any restored cutover. No production deployment/cutover or destructive DB action is authorized by local development.
Optional Stripe sandbox inputs remain SAAS_STRIPE_ALPHA_API_KEY, SAAS_STRIPE_ALPHA_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, SAAS_STRIPE_ALPHA_WEBHOOK_SECRET, SAAS_STRIPE_ALPHA_ACCOUNT_ID and corresponding BRAVO names. They are process inputs for saas/m4-sandbox.cjs; two independent sk_test/pk_test merchant accounts are required. Missing inputs return pending/exit 2 before database access. Local actual SDK/owned protocol fixtures do not replace actual Stripe sandbox/official reachable TLS callbacks/Elements/3DS. Current runtime has no configured merchant keys; no live key or real-money test is authorized.
M6: complete isolation matrix, independent security/license/CVE/dependency/performance, actual external acceptance and deployment/monitoring/rollback release checks. All AI/helpdesk/CRM/marketing/behavior analytics is phase two. Separate merchant UI remains paused.
Save current evidence only under the new current-phase directory; preserve previous archives. Prior authorization covers committing/pushing SaaS source and docs to victors2021/store-saas/saas-mvp; verify remote SHA before reporting.
Repository membership is preserved; retain original/local checkouts and origins. Install/start/network/environment changes here are saved drafts only. Review/save in environment settings, then publish the configuration and installed filesystem snapshot to activate them. Draft saving does not configure secrets, apply network rules or prove fresh-task restoration.
